episode.episode_title: OpenAI's Legal Brief: What Astra for Law Actually Adds
episode.episode_description: OpenAI has launched Astra for Law, combining GPT-6 Astra with legal-specific instructions and a search index spanning more than 230 million U.S. legal URLs. We look at what the product adds, how its privacy controls differ by deployment, and what lawyers still need to verify.

short.title: OpenAI brings GPT-6 Astra to the legal profession
short.description:
